text:
marina: rolled Ivy-9B int4 into a 3-node canary this morning. p99 for short-chat traces looks elevated (~18%) vs baseline.

marina: quick logs show memcpy spikes and occasional OOM-fallbacks on first requests.

sanjay: looks like kv cache miss + prefetch allocation path. Are we using prefetch for Ivy in int4?

marta: yes default prefetch=on. toggled it off on one node and p99 dropped ~9ms.

lucas: propose two tiny experiments on prod-sampled replay:
- Config 1: prefetch=false, max_batch=4, slot_reserve_mb=128, eviction_threshold=0.65
- Config 2: prefetch=true, max_batch=3, warmup_reserve_mb=256 for 25s, eviction_threshold=0.75

marina: launching Config 1 on group-alpha. deploy-bot: canary deploy started.

deploy-bot: canary run complete (30m). artifact: /replay/ivy/3627890000/cfg1.json

marta: cfg1 results: p99 -11ms, OOM-fallbacks down 72%, small QA EM drop ~0.7%.

marina: starting Config 2 on group-beta. deploy-bot: canary run complete (30m). artifact: /replay/ivy/3627890000/cfg2.json

lucas: cfg2 results: p99 -6ms, OOM-fallbacks down 38%, QA stable. warmup path reduced cold-start spikes but less steady-state gain.

sanjay: conclusion: pref=false better latency but minor QA hit. plan: make Config 2 the safe canary default, run a 24h Config 1 variant with max_new_tokens_default=96 to see if EM recovers. open perf ticket for memcpy path.

marta: noted. I'll file RI-2026-ivy-memcpy and add warmup snippet to onboarding template.

marina: updated model catalog draft with recommended defaults (canary): prefetch=on, max_batch=3, eviction=0.75, warmup_reserve=256MB, max_new_tokens_default=64. Will report after 24h run. :white_check_mark:
